      "score": 0.8,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes a privacy failure where transactions intended for private broadcast leak to public peers via wallet rebroadcasts or submitpackage, linking the transaction origin to the node. In P2P, privacy of transaction origin is explicitly a top-tier concern, and leaving known pathways for unintended public broadcast unresolved directly undermines the security and privacy guarantees of private broadcast."
